limitations: Read-only review: no campaign point, solver campaign, git add/commit, or deletion was performed; only this receipt was written.

The frozen IMPL2 identity is stale at HEAD (integrated_2t.py changed after the identity/preregistration freeze), so the production IMPL2 preflight fails closed and the resume path could not be executed end-to-end at HEAD. Claims were verified from production code plus the bounded tests.

The local campaign manifest is unsigned; the external artifact verifier detects corruption and binding mismatch but is not an authenticity source. A coherent rewrite of manifest plus checkpoint/result bytes is outside the integrity check.
Per instructions, the full D2 spawn/equivalence test and the full integrated_2t suite were not rerun; the prior receipts report them, but this review did not reproduce them.
Bounded negative coverage is incomplete for the trace-origin branches listed in TRACE-ORIGIN-NEGATIVE-TEST-COVERAGE; those were verified by code inspection.

The three implementation commits listed in the request predate later solver/perf commits (ea2ff2d, f6a955c) that changed integrated_2t.py; this review applies to the current HEAD tree, not only to those three commits.
no_campaign_statement: No campaign point was started; historical v1/IMPL2 artifacts were not modified.
